stories.summary: The Supreme Court has directed a Delhi commercial court to examine whether banks followed loan agreements with builders before pursuing homebuyers for payments on unfinished flats. The order follows cases where lenders disbursed funds to developers without verifying construction progress. Banks may now face closer scrutiny.

stories.title: Nexus Select Trust acquires Kolkata mall for Rs 355 crore
stories.summary: Nexus Select Trust has acquired the 396,609 sq ft Diamond Plaza Mall in Kolkata for Rs 355 crore. The transaction expands the retail REIT’s presence in eastern India, adding to its existing portfolio of 19 malls. The trust also manages the city’s South City Mall.

stories.summary: Filmmaker Rakesh Roshan’s production house has leased a 2,727 sq ft office at Lotus Corporate Park in Mumbai to Fuji Silvertech Concrete. The five-year agreement carries a starting monthly rent of Rs 7 lakh. The deal includes three basement parking spaces for the tenant.

Data center demand drives 50 million square feet of industrial leasing
stories.summary: Industrial leasing tied to data center development reached 50 million square feet through the third quarter of 2026, according to Cushman and Wakefield. This figure exceeds the total for all of 2025 by 113 percent. Data center infrastructure is now a primary driver of industrial real estate demand.

The report, titled Data Centers: The Newest Logistics Demand Engine, found that industrial leasing associated with data

stories.title: Mounds View industrial building sells for $7.17 million
stories.summary: North Park Group has acquired a 53,839-square-foot industrial building in Mounds View for $7.17 million. The property is located in the Mounds View Industrial Park and was sold by Fedtech Partners. Investment in Twin Cities-area industrial real estate continues.

stories.title: Cravey Real Estate facilitates sale of Texas industrial facility
stories.summary: Cravey Real Estate Services has facilitated the sale of a 13,279-square-foot industrial facility in Robstown, Texas, to Rolfson Oil. The property sits on 10 acres and includes administrative offices and warehouse space. The sale price was not disclosed.

stories.title: Olathe warehouse project replaces data center rumors
stories.summary: City officials in Olathe have confirmed that a proposed 1,006,880-square-foot industrial facility on 175th Street will be a warehouse and distribution center, not a data center. The project is expected to create more than 700 jobs. Rumors of a data center had previously circulated.

stories.title: Brennan Investment Group acquires Bethlehem industrial facility
stories.summary: Brennan Investment Group has acquired a 100,790-square-foot industrial facility in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania. The property sits on 7.3 acres near major transportation corridors and features LED lighting and temperature-controlled warehouse space. The firm focuses on industrial real estate investment.

stories.title: India projects space economy to hit $45 billion by 2036
stories.summary: India's space economy is projected to grow from nearly $9 billion to $45 billion by 2036, according to Minister Jitendra Singh. The government attributes this expansion to space reforms and private sector participation, with the number of startups reportedly reaching 500. Space is becoming a crowded sector.

stories.title: India targets $45 billion space economy in under a decade
stories.summary: India's space economy is expected to reach $45 billion within ten years, up from its current $9 billion valuation, according to Minister Jitendra Singh. The government is encouraging domestic firms to increase investment and facilitate foreign capital. The sector is expanding its reach into railways and defence.

stories.title: Telangana advances land acquisition for Hyderabad ring road
stories.summary: The Telangana government is planning land acquisition for the 201-kilometre southern section of the Regional Ring Road around Hyderabad. Officials have identified 4,962 acres across 90 villages for the project. The proposed loop is intended to connect to the existing outer corridor near the city.

stories.title: Assam inaugurates new state house in Delhi
stories.summary: Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma inaugurated a new Assam House in Dwarka, Delhi, constructed at a cost of 22 crore rupees. The facility includes 21 guest rooms and two VIP suites intended for students and visitors from the state. The building spans 2,827 square metres.

stories.title: Mumbai Metro 11 survey to assess 800 structures
stories.summary: The Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation is beginning a socio-economic survey of 800 buildings along the proposed 17.5km underground Metro 11 corridor. Property owners have been asked to provide documentation to the agency. The line is planned to connect Wadala to the Gateway of India.

stories.title: Pune Metro Pink Line ridership nears 50,000 daily
stories.summary: The Pune Metro Pink Line has recorded nearly 50,000 daily passengers ahead of the opening of two new stations in Balewadi. Operators have installed additional fare collection gates to manage footfall at the busiest stops. The line currently connects Maan to the Civil Court in Shivajinagar.

stories.title: Greater Noida plans footbridge for expressway crossing
stories.summary: The Greater Noida Industrial Development Authority plans to build a footbridge near Zero Point on the Noida Expressway. The area serves as a transit hub for commuters heading to Agra and other cities. Pedestrians currently cross the expressway amid high-speed traffic to reach bus and cab services.

stories.title: India bullet train trial phase expected in 2027
stories.summary: India's first bullet train project is expected to enter its trial phase in May 2027, according to Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw. Testing will begin on the 50-km Surat-Bilimora section of the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor. Signalling work for the route is scheduled to be completed by January 2027.

stories.title: Arctic trade route gains geopolitical focus
stories.summary: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation has reiterated its commitment to the 2026 Connectivity Blueprint, aiming to strengthen the Trans Arctic Maritime Corridor. The route is being positioned as a potential alternative for global trade as regional conflicts disrupt traditional energy flows from West Asia.

stories.title: New York law requires disclosure of private real estate listings
stories.summary: Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law requiring real estate agents to obtain signed disclosure forms from homeowners who sell properties through private channels. The legislation aims to address listings not shared on public multiple listing services. Agents who fail to disclose these private arrangements face potential fines.

stories.title: New York enacts transparency law for real estate listings
stories.summary: New York has enacted the Fair and Transparent Real Estate Listings Act, establishing public marketing as the default for residential properties. The law places new restrictions on homes sold exclusively through private or limited-access networks. The state aims to make real estate data more accessible to the public.

stories.title: FHFA raises 2027 conforming loan limit to $855,400
stories.summary: The Federal Housing Finance Agency will increase the baseline conforming loan limit to $855,400 for 2027. This 2.71 percent rise reflects slower home price growth compared to previous years. Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac are authorized to purchase loans up to this balance in most U.S. counties.

stories.title: Federal agency boosts size of most single-family loans the government can guarantee to $855,400 - The Washington Post
FHFA maintains multifamily loan caps at $176 billion
stories.summary: The Federal Housing Finance Agency has set the 2027 multifamily purchase limits at $88 billion each for Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac. At least half of this business must be mission-driven affordable housing. The regulator retains the ability to raise these limits if market conditions warrant growth.

stories.title: Maxine Waters criticizes housing market performance
stories.summary: Representative Maxine Waters issued a statement citing home sales falling to their lowest levels since the Great Recession. She noted that mortgage rates have remained above 7 percent for eight consecutive weeks. The ranking member called for immediate action to address the ongoing housing affordability crisis.

stories.title: Maxine Waters outlines agenda for financial services committee
stories.summary: Representative Maxine Waters has circulated a letter to colleagues detailing her legislative agenda should she become Chairwoman of the House Financial Services Committee in 2027. The proposal includes policy goals for banks, fintech companies and payment providers. The committee is preparing for a new congressional session.

stories.title: Cochin Shipyard joint venture faces scrutiny
stories.summary: A joint venture between Cochin Shipyard and Drydocks World to operate a ship repair facility in Kochi has drawn criticism. Reports suggest the 1,800 crore rupee deal was signed without necessary approvals from shareholders or the Department of Investment and Public Asset Management. The agreement remains under review.

stories.title: India’s Private Space Firms Need Orders to Scale, Regulator Says - Bloomberg.com
Six listed REITs distribute Rs 3,234 crore to unitholders in Q2 FY27
stories.summary: India's six publicly listed REITs distributed over Rs 3,234 crore to 5.25 lakh unitholders in the second quarter of FY27, according to the Indian REITs Association. Distributions have grown alongside the number of listed trusts, which rose from four in Q2 FY25 to six today.

stories.title: Six listed REITs distribute INR 3,234 crore to over 5.25 lakh unitholders in Q2 FY27
stories.summary: India’s six listed Real Estate Investment Trusts distributed more than INR 3,234 crore to over 5.25 lakh unitholders in the second quarter of FY27. The sector now manages more than 215 million square feet of Grade A office and retail space, with assets exceeding INR 3.30 lakh crore.

stories.title: Motilal Oswal Alternates launches Rs 3,000 crore fund for Grade A offices
stories.summary: Motilal Oswal Alternates has launched the India Assets Excellence Fund, targeting a corpus of up to Rs 3,000 crore. The fund aims to partner with established developers to invest in Grade A office projects across six major Indian markets at an early stage of development.

stories.title: Chandak Group secures Rs 200 crore for Mumbai housing project
stories.summary: Chandak Group has raised Rs 200 crore from investors, including Japan's Mori Trust and Route78 Partners, to fund its Chandak Highscape City residential project in Chembur, Mumbai. This investment marks the first venture into the Indian real estate market for Mori Trust.

stories.title: B-Right Realestate unlocks Rs 2,132.6 crore development opportunity
stories.summary: B-Right Realestate subsidiary Farewell Real Estate Private Limited has received a Letter of Intent from the Slum Rehabilitation Authority for a project in Mulund West. The company aims to rehabilitate 1,003 slum tenants, marking its entry into the eastern suburban real estate market of Mumbai.

stories.title: WHLR: Wheeler REIT to reverse split 1-for-4 effective November 27, 2026 - Quantisnow
Boardwalk REIT renews normal course issuer bid
stories.summary: The Toronto Stock Exchange has approved the renewal of Boardwalk REIT's normal course issuer bid. The Calgary-based landlord will continue repurchasing units on the open market for another year, with plans to establish an automatic purchase plan to facilitate buying during blackout periods.

stories.title: Ares Commercial Real Estate stock rating raised to Buy at UBS Group
stories.summary: UBS upgraded Ares Commercial Real Estate to Buy from Neutral, while lowering its price target to $4.50. The REIT reported quarterly earnings of $0.12 per share, exceeding the $0.04 consensus estimate, though analyst opinion on the stock remains mixed with a consensus rating of Hold.

stories.title: Ares Commercial Real Estate upgraded by UBS with a new price target - Quantisnow
AI-powered real estate company reAlpha expands into Illinois - Chicago Agent Magazine
Multifamily proptech moves deeper into operations
stories.summary: Multifamily proptech is increasing its focus on property operations through new investments and AI-powered tools. Bevado, formerly known as Frontdesk, raised $10 million to automate resident communication, joining a wave of recent funding and product launches from companies including Yardi, Reputation, Snappt, and Funnel.

stories.title: REITs join major brokerages on RESAAS commercial data platform
stories.summary: REITs are joining the commercial data platform operated by Vancouver-based RESAAS Services. The company, which began 15 years ago by connecting real estate agents, is now expanding its focus into the United States and Western Europe to facilitate the sharing of sensitive commercial property data.

stories.title: I still believe in billboards in the age of the algorithm
stories.summary: Digital media is fast and cheap, but billboards offer a reach that does not require users to stop scrolling. For real estate agents building careers on reputation, a billboard on a high-traffic corner provides steady, unavoidable visibility that is difficult to manufacture through digital algorithms alone.

stories.title: Homes sold off the MLS leave sellers and the market in the dark
stories.summary: For decades, the Multiple Listing Service has been the primary tool for determining home values through comparable sales. A growing number of transactions are now occurring off the MLS, including wholesaling, where investors sell contracts to other buyers without listing the property on the public market.

stories.title: Home prices rose 2.1% in September, inflation rose faster
stories.summary: Home prices rose 2.1% year-over-year in September, according to the S&P CoreLogic Case-Shiller Index. Inflation, however, reached 3.7% during the same period. This marks the 16th consecutive month in which U.S. home price growth has been outpaced by the rising cost of consumer goods.

stories.title: Raleigh woman evicted after landlord refuses to honor AI assistant deal
stories.summary: A North Carolina resident was evicted after her landlord refused to honor a payment agreement made via email. The leasing office later informed the tenant that the deal was arranged by an AI assistant, not a human, and was therefore not considered a valid agreement.

stories.title: Real estate agent, 73, built retirement around five rental properties
stories.summary: A 73-year-old real estate agent is reconsidering her retirement plan after rental demand for her five properties declined. With several units sitting empty, the monthly cash flow that once supported her has disappeared while mortgage obligations remain. She is now considering selling her portfolio.

stories.title: ‘Buyers are out for blood’: With home sales at a record low, buyers are calling the shots - MarketWatch
Adani Cement begins electric truck fleet deployment
stories.summary: Adani Cement has started using heavy-duty electric trucks at its Sanghi plant in Gujarat. The company aims to deploy 410 vehicles by March 2027 and over 2,000 by 2030 to cut logistics costs and emissions. It claims the initial fleet will displace 11 million litres of diesel annually.

stories.title: Saint-Gobain plans Rs 11,000 crore investment in India
stories.summary: French building-materials group Saint-Gobain will invest Rs 11,000 crore in India over the next five years to expand manufacturing and sustainable product lines. The company identifies India as a top-five global market, citing rising incomes and consumer aspirations as primary drivers for the increased capital expenditure.

stories.title: Saint-Gobain identifies India as top-five global market
stories.summary: Saint-Gobain plans to invest Rs 11,000 crore over five years to expand manufacturing and sustainable building solutions in India. The company cites rising per capita income and modern construction awareness as reasons for the expansion. It intends to adapt global technologies specifically for Indian conditions.

stories.title: Shalimar Paints to merge with promoter Infra Market
stories.summary: Shalimar Paints is set to merge with its promoter Infra Market in a deal valuing the combined entity at approximately EUR 2.1 billion. The transaction aims to transform the historic paint manufacturer into a diversified building-materials platform and introduce new institutional investors to the shareholder register.

stories.title: Shalimar Paints & Infra.Market Merge in Rs. 19,839 Crore Deal - Realty Plus Magazine
Olive mill wastewater tested for construction use
stories.summary: Research published in the journal Cleaner Water examines using olive mill wastewater as a partial replacement for freshwater in concrete and bricks. The study indicates that while the effluent can be repurposed, its application is restricted by material-specific trade-offs rather than consistent performance improvements across all mixtures.

stories.title: Cellulose nanofibers tested as cement-free binder
stories.summary: A proof-of-concept study in Scientific Reports suggests that cellulose nanofiber gel can bind mineral sand into composites with compressive strengths similar to rammed earth. The research is currently unedited and describes an early composition map for a potential cement-free construction material.

stories.title: Renewable bamboo is key to decarbonizing construction - Manila Bulletin
Kenya explores plastic-to-road technology
stories.summary: The Kenya National Highways Authority is researching technology to convert recycled plastic waste into road construction materials. The initiative involves discussions with a Japanese delegation including representatives from the Japan International Cooperation Agency, Nippon Road Company, Kao Corporation and Shimizu Corporation.

stories.title: Neral railway station receives IGBC Gold rating
stories.summary: Neral railway station has earned an Indian Green Building Council Gold rating for its energy-efficient infrastructure. The facility features a 375 kWp rooftop solar system, LED lighting and star-rated electrical equipment. The rating follows a final assessment of the station's passenger amenities and green initiatives.

stories.title: Signature Global reports GRESB sustainability score
stories.summary: Signature Global scored 97.8 out of 100 in the latest GRESB Real Estate Assessment, up from 84 last year. The company achieved a perfect score in reporting and 99.8 per cent in energy, ranking 12th globally in its residential peer group for environmental, social and governance performance.

stories.title: Sikkim’s Sustainable Architecture: Building in Harmony with Nature - Realty Plus Magazine
Utilities for Net Zero Alliance reports grid expansion
stories.summary: Members of the Utilities for Net Zero Alliance deployed over 21,000 km of new electricity grids in 2025. The group reports combined annual investment plans of at least $156 billion across storage and renewables, as the industry works toward increasing electricity's share of global final energy consumption.

stories.title: India and Netherlands sign green sea corridor agreement
stories.summary: India and the Netherlands signed a letter of intent to establish a green and digital sea corridor between Indian ports and the Port of Rotterdam. The agreement was formalised during India Maritime Week in Mumbai, which hosted participants from over 93 countries.

stories.title: 105 Victoria Street project details
stories.summary: The 105 Victoria Street development in London features design work by architects KPF, Henning Larsen and Adamson Associates. The project is positioned as a net-zero office development.

stories.title: KPIT Technologies gets SBTi validation for net-zero emissions targets by FY50 - ET Auto
Construction adhesives market projected to grow
stories.summary: The global construction adhesives market is expected to reach US$ 13.8 billion in 2026 and grow to US$ 19.9 billion by 2033. The sector is supported by the use of bonding materials to replace mechanical fasteners in residential and commercial building projects.

stories.title: Geneva nonprofit receives grant for material salvage
stories.summary: ReUse Systems has received a New York State Pollution Prevention Institute grant to salvage building materials and furniture before demolition. The nonprofit will test the project across four counties, building on earlier pilot work conducted with Hobart and William Smith Colleges.

stories.title: Canadian Retail Poised to Lead CRE Rent Growth Through 2028 - Business Wire
Cable TV mogul finds buyer for Palm Beach estate asking $75M - The Real Deal
Power couple's Pacific Heights estate nears San Francisco's record price for a home sale - The Business Journals
Boardwalk sells Edmonton multi-family portfolio for $106.5M
stories.summary: Boardwalk Real Estate Investment Trust has sold its 536-unit Edmonton portfolio for $106.5 million. The deal, which includes three properties built between 1969 and 1978, marks the largest multi-family transaction in the city so far this year. The units sold for an average of $199,999 each.

stories.title: Sub-£2bn REITs “don’t tick the boxes”, says LondonMetric boss - Estates Gazette
LondonMetric looks to sell small and buy big - Investors' Chronicle
Vastned acquires retail property in Córdoba for €12 million
stories.summary: Vastned has acquired a retail property in Córdoba for €12 million. The site is fully leased to cosmetics chain Druni and generates €0.72 million in annual rent. CEO Sven Bosman described the move as part of a strategy for selective yet sustainable growth in core markets.

stories.title: When will Britain's housing market reach the bottom
stories.summary: For decades, British property ownership has functioned as a primary instrument for private wealth accumulation. Generations have viewed rising home values as evidence of personal financial acumen rather than the result of cheap credit, restrictive planning laws and the progressive inflation of a scarce asset.

stories.title: Paris apartment prices fall year-on-year
stories.summary: The mean price of resale apartments in Paris fell 1.3 percent in the third quarter compared to a year earlier, according to Insee. The decline follows two European Central Bank interest-rate increases and a dip in consumer confidence to a 13-year low. The figures remain unadjusted.
